name: Step-Audio-EditX
weights: open (code Apache-2.0; weights licence not stated on the model page)
access: Hugging Face weights stepfun-ai/Step-Audio-EditX (3B) and a 4-bit AWQ build, plus the Step-Audio-Tokenizer
stepfun-ai/Step-Audio-EditX repository: command-line scripts, Gradio app, Docker, vLLM support (2026-01-23)
StepFun Audio Studio and Hugging Face Space (an API key from the StepFun Open Platform is needed for the studio)

voice.input_audio: A reference or source clip of up to about 30 seconds with its transcript, plus target text for cloning, or an edit type and edit value; paralinguistic tags in the text [hf-editx]
voice.output_audio: Wave files, one per edit iteration (for example an iter1 and an iter2 file); the pages read state no sample rate [hf-editx]
voice.voices: custom cloning from a clip; editing keeps the speaker of the source clip [hf-editx]
languages: Mandarin, English, Sichuanese and Cantonese for cloning; Japanese and Korean added on 2025-11-28; a bracket tag names the dialect or language before the text [hf-editx]
voice.turn_detection: none: a synthesis and editing model
voice.session_limit: The README advises keeping audio under 30 seconds per inference [hf-editx]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Open weights, no price. About 12 GB of GPU memory is the critical value and 16 GB is safer, on an NVIDIA GPU with CUDA; tested on one L40S; Linux; Python 3.12 or later and PyTorch 2.9.1 or later [hf-editx]. The hosted Audio Studio prices were not read

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Speech Arena Elo (provider voice leaderboard)
benchmarks.setting: blind pairwise listener votes; listed as Step Audio EditX (Mar 2026), open weights; the model page headline gives 1092.01 and the leaderboard data in the same page gives 1095.18

benchmarks.name: Emotion editing accuracy after 3 iterations on other systems' voices, average of Chinese and English (README table)
benchmarks.setting: edits of MiniMax-2.6-hd voices; iteration 0 (no edit) scores 63.3; the same table gives 74.5 for Doubao-Seed-TTS-2.0 voices; speaking-style accuracy rises from 44.2 to 65.8 for MiniMax voices

unknown: generation: the maker numbers no generation of this model

weights licence: the README states the code licence only, and the Hugging Face licence field is empty [hf-editx] [hf-editx-api]
